reason: The policy allows cancelling only the full pending order or modifying item options to a different variant of the same product (each removed item must be replaced with a new item id of the same product type). There is no policy-supported action for removing/canceling only a subset of items from a pending order while keeping the rest. The candidate call to modify_pending_order_items with item_ids for the three items but an empty new_item_ids list does not fit this tool's contract (positions must match with same-product replacement items) and is being used to simulate a partial cancellation/removal that the policy does not define. The entire conversation confirmed a 'partial cancellation' of specific items from order #W1845024, but the only documented cancellation action applies to the whole order, and modify_pending_order_items cannot delete items without valid replacement items of the same product type.
policy_references: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending'... After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled'
For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
